patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I threw up something that looked like coffee grounds, and my stools have been black and tarry. I get lightheaded when I stand. I drink a fair bit, and I take ibuprofen for my knees.
clinical.presentationShort: 55yo M — coffee-ground emesis and melena, orthostatic, NSAID + alcohol use — upper GI bleed.
clinical.presentationLong: 55-year-old male with coffee-ground emesis, melena, and orthostatic lightheadedness on a background of NSAID and alcohol use — an upper gastrointestinal bleed.

diagnosis.primary: Upper GI bleed (peptic ulcer / possible varices)
diagnosis.disposition: Acute → two large-bore IVs, type & cross, PPI (± octreotide if variceal), GI for urgent endoscopy; can decompensate fast.
diagnosis.why: Black tarry stool + coffee-ground vomit = upper GI bleed. Two big IVs, type & cross/transfuse, urgent scope.
diagnosis.redFlag: Coffee-ground/bloody emesis + melena + orthostasis = active GI bleed; looks okay until they don't.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, one hand resting on his stomach, looks weak
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 55-year-old man, pale and drained, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: seated, one hand resting on his stomach, looking weak. Expression: pale, washed-out, and tired. Clearly visible: a pale, drained face and a hand resting on the stomach. No text, no logos.
